register.labelZh: CRY 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: cry for justice、change 或 action 可以表示人們強烈而迫切地要求某事。；cry off 可以清楚表示某人原本答應參加,但後來決定退出。；cry out 可以描述因痛楚、恐懼或驚訝而突然發出的叫聲。；這些片語動詞也可以表達強烈要求、臨時退出和突然大叫,而不只是流淚哭泣。
register.summaryEn: Cry for justice, change or action shows that people want something strongly and urgently. Cry off clearly shows that someone had agreed to take part but later decided not to do so. Cry out can describe a sudden shout caused by pain, fear or surprise. These expressions help you understand demands, cancelled plans and sudden shouts—not only tears.
